title: Research: conditional independent audit of discussion 1636's five-call cover obstruction (no new kappa)
body:
## Scope and result

This adds `research/centre-fivecall-cover-audit/`, an independent, conditional check of the inherited-route obstruction already reported by Tuafo in [discussion 1636](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1636). **No new supplier or κ, and no priority claim** for the five-call identity or its reported failure. The added value is an independent standard-library checker, an explicit statement of the premise the obstruction needs, and a small corollary.

**Source-bound part.** The retained complex route exchanges a port normal's 8-dimensional complement with each fresh stage. The checker tests all `4·112² = 50,176` ordered stage/port pairs on the 112 selected port labels with four fresh stages, using exact GF(2) arithmetic. `rho_(s,p)rho_(s,q)` preserves the fresh space exactly when `p=q`: 448 pairs preserve it and 49,728 do not. A written subspace proof gives the same implication. The retained Hamming sign-line geometry gives 112 normalized rows, `R^T R = 14I` and `M_pp = 0` for `M = I−RR^T`.

**Conditional part (review fix).** The five-call word is pinned verbatim from [comment 18915216](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1636#discussioncomment-18915216) in `DISCUSSION-1636-PIN.json`, with body hashes. The checker parses that word and requires it to equal the coefficients it checks. There is no candidate package or head. Exact multiplication gives the bank exchange at both eigenvalues `M = 1, −13`.

The `[[1,0],[131/144,1]]` same-cover/same-port block needs one more premise. Same-cover projection must be multiplicative: no path that leaves the starting cover class returns before the word ends. One transition per fresh stage implies this. This package does **not** derive it for the five-call word, because discussion 1636 does not say how its five calls map to the four fresh stages. If two transitions share a stage, `p→q→p` returns (`rho_(s,q)rho_(s,p)·rho_(s,p)rho_(s,q) = 1`) and terms like `(M²)_pp` enter the block. A two-port fixture shows such a return changing a same-port entry from 1 to 2. So this corroborates the five-call failure **conditionally**, under the premise that discussion 1636's argument uses implicitly.

**Corollary.** Under the same no-return premise, any two-stream elementary-shear word needs at least **three center-bearing pulses** for the projected exchange. Each `L(cM+dK)` or `U(cM+dK)` projects to `L(d)` or `U(d)`. No two shears give zero on both diagonal entries, which a polynomial check confirms for all four orientation patterns, while `L(1), U(−1), L(1)` attains the exchange. This is the classical three-shear count for a quarter-turn. It counts pulses, not paid rank mass.

## Task, base and overlap

- Card `centre-path-sharing`, priority revision 3, chooser nonce `0226cac72ec885cf8c74b837f6e4ed1b`, scope key `184695337cedab03152e`, refined to this falsification audit.
- Package base and source pins `1f7a934975e5eacaf83511c9ac870263bf095e05`, unchanged on main through `0b1cccf8`, onto which the branch is rebased.
- `find_overlap.py --refresh` was run at 2026-10-14 05:50 EDT (446 open PRs, 418 discussions). Discussion 1636 has only the claim and two top-level comments (04:47Z and 04:59Z). Tuafo released the inherited-geometry claim in the second comment. #1516 concerns one-call centre hosting. PR1696 and PR1777 bound GL2(F2) call counts in a different model.

## Verification and limitations

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/centre-fivecall-cover-audit/verify.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/centre-fivecall-cover-audit
```

Both pass on macOS (Python 3.12), and the verifier passes standalone on 3.10 and 3.14. The onboarding and replay-selection unit tests pass on the rebased branch. The checker constructs each port's orthogonal frame and tests every stage involution and all 50,176 pairs. It rebuilds the sign lines, computes the exact rational matrices, and checks the two-pulse lemma and the return-path fixture. Five controls must fail: a duplicate port, a corrupt frame column, a changed middle coefficient, an off-spectrum substitution and a tampered discussion pin.

Not covered: the routed five-call composition itself (see the premise above), the provisional candidate's 704 dirty columns, complex phases, controller, helper hosting, precision/tape and any supplier invoice. No selected cold replay was run, because selected sources are unchanged.

## Open next questions

1. Can a changed route or a paid intertwiner realize the local identity?
2. Does the five-call word's actual stage assignment satisfy the no-return premise? The first step is an exact routed same-cover block that includes two-hop returns.
3. Can an on-disk five-call candidate be pinned for candidate-specific review?

## Credit and assistance

Tuafo (discussion 1636, with the AI assistance declared there) supplied the five-call identity and the initial global obstruction. The retained split-centres complex and PR425 Hamming proofs supply the route and sign-line geometry. The selected #1094 review retains the supplier ancestry.

Prepared by Josie Elliston with substantial AI assistance. OpenAI Codex drafted the package offline (session 14b of a donated overnight run). Claude (Anthropic) reviewed it, pinned the discussion text, made the no-return premise explicit, narrowed the source-binding claims and published it. A separate read-only Codex review flagged both issues. No independent human review. Apache-2.0.
